name: Tasty Dairy Specialities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Tasty Dairy Specialities Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and sale of Dairy Products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) Core Activity: 
TDSL is in the business of processing milk, 
bulk milk procurement, and handling – primarily 
catering to bulk institutional customers.
b) Value-Added Products:
Skimmed Milk Powder, Butter, Ghee, Other dairy derivatives
c) Brand Portfolio:
Ujjwal, Shikhar, Verifresh, Cima, Mithai Master

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -56.3% over past five years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -39.8%
